verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs describe a single inference cloud serving LLMs alongside vision/OCR, image generation (FLUX, Stable Diffusion), video generation, speech recognition (Whisper) and text-to-speech, so all three modalities in the story are available on the same platform. The evidence is catalog-level marketing rather than API reference material. Missing for 10: documented endpoint/request details for calling the vision, audio and image models, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these non-chat modalities work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud that makes it simple to run the latest machine learning models at scale — LLMs, vision, embeddings, image generation, video generation, speech, and more.
FLUX, Stable Diffusion, text-to-video, and more.
Multimodal models for visual understanding and document text extraction.
